instruction: Remove expired payment cards from all my app accounts that have payment cards.
notes: Apps with payment cards are amazon, spotify and venmo (the evaluation checks only these three PaymentCard tables). For each app: login with the supervisor's email and the password from show_account_passwords, list cards with show_payment_cards, then delete every card whose expiry (year, month) is before the current date 2023-05-18 (a card expiring in 2023-05 is still valid). Card expiry is modeled as the static world fact (expired ?c); the agent learns it from show_payment_cards, which the model captures with (cards-listed ?app) as a precondition of delete. The delete action requires (expired ?c) so valid cards are never removed (no added/updated cards allowed). The problem instantiates a representative world with one expired and one valid card per app; at runtime the delete step is repeated for every expired card found (the reference solution's 12 API count suggests one extra deletion somewhere), and complete_task is called with no answer, carrying the three deleted expired cards only as record parameters so its precondition equals the goal.
